"""Continue review/scoring after a terminal guard stop; training stays untouched."""

import os
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path

import psutil
from train_directional_bank_trial import guard,read,ref,save

repo=Path('/home/dllu/proj/demosaic')
root=repo/'.cache/quality-20261103/V157-spatial-rgb-v1'
training=read(root/'plan-v1.json');guard(training)
recovery=read(root/'review-recovery-plan-v1.json');guard(recovery)
assert read(root/'status-v1.json')['status']=='completed-matched-training-awaiting-fixed-quality-review'
assert read(root/'postprocess-status-v1.json')['status']=='failed-review-preserve-evidence-no-restart'
post=root/'postprocess-v2'
plan={'root':str(root),'design':ref(root/'quality-design-v1.json'),
      'recovery_plan':ref(root/'review-recovery-plan-v1.json'),
      'inputs':[ref(root/'plan-v1.json'),ref(root/'quality-design-v1.json'),
                ref(root/'review-recovery-plan-v1.json'),ref(root/'review-checkpoint-readiness-v1.json'),
                ref(root/'postprocess-status-v1.json')],
      'frozen_files':{str(p):ref(p)['sha256'] for p in (post/'scripts').glob('*.py')},
      'controller':dict(ref(Path(__file__)),text=Path(__file__).read_text()),
      'scope':'New review revision after preserved terminal disk guard. CPU checkpoint validation already passed before initial review. Reuse exact controls,bitwise replay554 raw prefix,write1090 remaining arrays external.1644 new calls plus2198 preserved initial=3842 actual review calls. Then same independent scores/audit/native ROIs. No training restart,model/data/loss/endpoint changes or old evidence deletion.'}
assert not (root/'postprocess-plan-v2.json').exists();save(root/'postprocess-plan-v2.json',plan)
(root/'postprocess-controller-v2.claim').open('x').close()
env=os.environ.copy()
env['PYTHONPATH']=':'.join(str(p) for p in [post/'scripts',Path(training['work'])/'scripts',Path(training['work'])/'src'])
env['OMP_NUM_THREADS']=env['OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS']='1'
env['HF_HUB_OFFLINE']=env['TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE']='1'
env['CUBLAS_WORKSPACE_CONFIG']=':4096:8'
status={'status':'running-recovery-review','owner':{'pid':os.getpid(),'created':psutil.Process().create_time()},
        'completed':{},'preserved_previous_status':ref(root/'postprocess-status-v1.json')}
save(root/'postprocess-status-v2.json',status)
for stage,name in [('review','resume_spatial_rgb_review.py'),('scores','score_spatial_rgb_trial.py'),
                   ('metric-audit','audit_spatial_rgb_trial.py'),('render','render_spatial_rgb_trial.py')]:
    guard(training);guard(plan);guard(recovery)
    with (root/('postprocess-'+stage+'-v2.log')).open('x') as log:
        child=subprocess.Popen([str(repo/'.venv/bin/python'),str(post/'scripts'/name),str(root)],cwd=repo,env=env,
                               stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
        owner={'pid':child.pid,'created':psutil.Process(child.pid).create_time()}
        status.update(status='running-'+stage,stage=stage,child_owner=owner)
        save(root/'postprocess-status-v2.json',status)
        code=child.wait()
    status['completed'][stage]={'owner':owner,'returncode':code}
    if code:
        status['status']='failed-'+stage+'-preserve-evidence-no-restart'
        save(root/'postprocess-status-v2.json',status)
        raise RuntimeError(status['status'])
status['status']='completed-four-endpoint-audits-and-rendering-awaiting-actual-native-viewing'
save(root/'postprocess-status-v2.json',status)
print(status['status'],flush=True)
